title: How modern meta art incorporate Eastern philosophies

commenti.body:
>Prudence Farrow, the sister of Mia Farrow (of Rosemary's Baby and most of 80s Woody Allen's career fame), receives yoga training from the Swami Satchidananda in November 1967. Farrow was the inspiration for the Beatles song ‘Dear Prudence’.The Beach Boys "Transcendental Meditation"

Prudence Farrow studied with Maharihsi Mahesh YOgi, founder of Transcendental Meditation. [Swami Satchidananda](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Swami_Satchidananda_Saraswati) was an entirely different person, promoting both an entirely different style of Yoga *and* a completely different interpretation of things that Maharishi Mahesh Yogi.

.


While it might well be that someone, somewhere has introduced TM into literature, I'm not aware of any.

I *do* assert that the final scenes and credits of David Lynch's INLAND EMPIRE are visual enactments and visualizations of various titles, lectures and favorite phrases of Maharishi Mahesh Yogi, and arguably, the entire movie is a metaphor reincarnation and enlightenment as taught by MMY, you'd have to be very familiar with the lectures and sayings of MMY to catch the relationship.

.

>with everything leading up to it needing attention (meditation) from the viewers.


this is a perfect example of how esoteric such references would be as the deepest level of TM is when you cease being aware of anything at all, and so, by definition, cannot have "attention."
